title: Verify Me!
tagline: We want to democratize the verification check mark on social media
description:
We are building an aggregator system for social verification in Lens protocol so other users can check your profile and immediately identify your level of trustworthiness with a visual cue.

We are starting with social verification but we would like to add proof of humanity protocols, verification challenging, NFT minting, among other things.
how_its_made:
As a first step we use wallet connect for a better mobile integration,  we considered an optimistic UI update trough all our webapp.

In order to get an accurate verification, you visit a lens profile from our webapp, were it will automatically allow you to visualize how many POAP's you have in common, so you can be sure that you met or co-occurred 1 or more times with that person before you can validate it.

We also added an algorithm that gives you more or less verification points depending on the number of POAP's you have in common, and when you validate X number of people, the validation is completed 100% and our check is unlocked.
